content.user_title: Build Flutter Apps with Expert Patterns
content.value_statement: Flutter teams need consistent patterns for state, navigation, widgets, and performance. This skill provides focused Flutter 3 and Dart guidance for production app work.
actual_capabilities: Guides Flutter 3 project setup with feature-based folder structure and pubspec dependencies.
Shows Riverpod providers, notifiers, async state, and selective rebuild patterns.
Explains Bloc and Cubit structures for event-driven state management.
Provides GoRouter route, redirect, shell route, and navigation patterns.
Recommends widget patterns using const constructors, responsive layouts, hooks, and slivers.
Lists performance practices for profiling, image handling, isolates, and rebuild reduction.
limitations: Does not run Flutter commands or verify builds by itself.
Assumes Flutter 3.19+, Dart 3.3+, and current package APIs.
Does not replace project-specific architecture review or product requirements.
Backend services, release signing, and store deployment are outside the main scope.

use_cases.title: Implement New Flutter Features
use_cases.description: Plan widgets, state ownership, routing, and tests for a new application feature.

use_cases.title: Standardize App Architecture
use_cases.description: Define feature folders, state patterns, shared widgets, and package choices for a Flutter project.

use_cases.title: Improve App Performance
use_cases.description: Find rebuild, image, list, and computation issues that affect smooth Flutter experiences.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Widget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a const Flutter widget for [screen or component]. Include responsive layout choices and explain where it belongs.

prompt_templates.title: Add State Management
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Riverpod state for [feature]. Include providers, notifier actions, async loading states, and widget usage.

prompt_templates.title: Design Navigation Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design GoRouter navigation for [app flow]. Include route hierarchy, auth redirects, shell routes, and deep link handling.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Performance and Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Flutter feature for architecture, rebuilds, state ownership, and performance. Suggest concrete changes and tests.

output_examples.input: I need a Flutter profile screen with editable user details.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline a const widget tree, Riverpod notifier responsibilities, form validation states, and widget test coverage.

output_examples.input: My app has route guards and bottom tabs.
output_examples.output: The skill would propose a GoRouter structure with auth redirects, shell routes, nested destinations, and navigation behaviors to verify.

output_examples.input: Scrolling janks in a product feed.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify rebuild sources, list rendering choices, cached images, RepaintBoundary use, isolate work, and DevTools measurements.

best_practices: Start with feature boundaries before choosing Riverpod, Bloc, or local widget state.
Use const constructors, stable keys, and selective provider watching for predictable rebuilds.
Pair generated code and routing changes with widget or integration tests.
anti_patterns: Do not use setState for app-wide state or shared business logic.
Do not place heavy computation on the UI thread.
Do not skip platform behavior, navigation edge cases, or performance profiling.

faq.question: Does this skill support Riverpod and Bloc?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Riverpod providers, notifiers, Bloc, Cubit, and event-driven state flows.

faq.question: Can it help with GoRouter?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers route setup, redirects, shell routes, nested routes, navigation methods, and deep links.

faq.question: Does it generate complete apps?
faq.answer: It can guide structure and feature implementation. Local builds, assets, backend integration, and product decisions still need project work.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it include performance guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers profiling, const widgets, provider selection, images, lists, isolates, and rebuild reduction.

faq.question: Is it focused on Flutter 3?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill targets Flutter 3.19+, Dart 3.3+, Riverpod 2.0, Bloc 8.x, and GoRouter.
